summary: Decodes 8-bit alpha-only texture data to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050). Loops over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming one byte per pixel, and writes RGB as 0.0 with the alpha channel set to the byte scaled by 0.0039215689 (the 1/255 float held in flt_59E460), writing four floats per pixel. If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float RGBA buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050).
Iterate over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels (this[1046] bytes), consuming one byte per pixel and writing four floats per pixel.
Set the red, green and blue channels to 0.0 for each pixel.
Decode the alpha channel as the byte value * 0.0039215689.
Advance the input pointer by one byte and the output pointer by four floats each iteration.
If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, run the post-processing cleanup on the decoded buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output_base) where output_base is computed as the base of the decoded float RGBA buffer (a4 - 4 * this[1046]).
